ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio dominated by low-intensity black pixels (~92%) with localized high-intensity white clusters (~8%) concentrated at distal tips and along surface abrasions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous black region covering the majority of the visible fluke; high-intensity white geometric blobs localized at the extreme distal left and right tips; sparse white pixel mottling and linear patterns scattered across the central and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes across the entire trailing edge boundary, featuring several prominent peaks on the upper-left and upper-right margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward and outward sweep from the median notch, terminating in sharp, acute distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels (approx. 20-30 individual units) localized at the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) of varying lengths, predominantly oriented vertically and diagonally across the central-right fluke surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast clusters at the fluke tips; numerous linear rake marks across the ventral surface; distinct circular/ring-shaped pixel patterns (lesions) on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of unique ring-shaped high-contrast scars on the mid-right lobe surface, isolated from linear abrasions.
